call_points.text: Margin guidance held: from 18.1% last year, management wants to inch toward 19%, with 20-20-20 aspirational.
The new semicon order is from an existing customer and takes annual business with it to about $75 million.
New-business peak annual revenue excluding ADS stood at ₹1,850 Cr as of June 2026.
ADS capacity is planned to generate about ₹3,500 Cr of revenue by FY31 across hangar, defence and new facility.
Auto capex at Pantnagar, Manesar and Bangalore comes on stream from the start of Q3FY27 and completes within a year.
Steel inflation is limited; aluminium and consumables rose, and customer pass-through talks are in process but not yet in the P&L.
No additional fundraise is needed now; leverage is described as very low and can fund capex.
Semicon customers see demand exceeding supply until FY29-FY30; aerospace risk is low barring a Boeing-type event.
Management still targets ₹8,000-9,000 Cr revenue by end of the decade, FY31.
FY26 capex stood at ₹509.7 Cr, with similar investment expected in FY27.
Cumulative unexecuted lifetime order backlog for ADS stands at ₹4,463.8 Cr.
Unexecuted order backlog for ADS business stood at ₹4,463.8 Cr as of March 2026.
Planned capex of ₹250 Cr over the next few years for ADS facility expansion.
EBITDA margin improved to 18.1% in FY26 from 17.1% in FY25.
